newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Matamoros opens 15 new plants.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Matamoros opens 15 new plants.

text.p: The bustling Mexican border city of Matamoros has opened 15 maquiladora in-bond assembly plants this year, and is studying 10 more projects, a city official said on Thursday.

Jorge Guerra, head of the Matamoros Development Committee, told Reuters the number of plants had grown from 95 last year, employing some 45,000 people, and that more were expected to be approved before year-end.
The new plants, that use low-cost Mexican labour to assemble mostly imported inputs into exportable goods, have led to the creation of some 2,000 jobs this year, he said.

The maquiladora industry has boomed in Mexico since the December 1994 peso devaluation halved the cost in dollar terms of Mexican labour, particularly in border cities like Matamoros that abuts Brownsville in southeastern Texas.
